effects.prompt: Single elevator arrival chime: one clean, bright bell ding with a short natural decay. Close-miked, dry room, no voices, no background noise.
Elevator car travelling inside its shaft: steady low electric motor hum with a soft cable and rail rumble, constant level from start to end. No ding, no doors, no voices.
Short burst of building construction: three quick hammer strikes on a steel beam followed by a brief power drill whir. Close and punchy, no voices, no music.
Short demolition crash: a concrete wall breaking apart and debris tumbling down, heavy low impact with a quick decay. Not an explosion, no voices, no music.
Old mechanical cash register sale: a bright drawer bell ring and the drawer sliding open with a light rattle of coins. Close-miked, no voices, no music.
Soft two-note notification chime for a game interface, gentle wooden marimba tones going up, friendly and calm, short tail. Not an alarm, no voices.
Urgent electronic security alarm: fast pulsing high-pitched beeps in a steady rhythm, tense and threatening, indoor building. No bell, no siren wail, no voices.
Building fire alarm bell: a loud metal bell ringing continuously with a rapid clapper, echoing in an indoor hallway. No electronic beeps, no voices.
Church wedding bells ringing joyfully: several bronze bells pealing in a cheerful descending pattern, heard from a city street. No organ, no choir, no voices.
Folded morning newspaper dropped onto a wooden hotel counter with a soft slap, followed by a quick paper rustle. Close-miked, quiet room, no voices.
Calm office tower lobby ambience: distant indistinct crowd murmur, footsteps on marble floor, faint echo of a large hall, steady and even throughout. No clear words, no music, no announcements.
One loud, clearly audible mouse click on a plastic button: a sharp, crisp tick right at the start, close-miked and dry, then silence. No reverb.
